files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Fixed
- Material Design Icon names entered in camelCase (e.g. `mdiCloud`, `mdiSwapHorizontal` — the exact form copied from the Pictogrammers/MDI site) now render for both services and categories. Previously only kebab-case (`mdi-cloud`) was recognized; the camelCase form fell through to the icon CDN and ultimately produced a 404, leaving services with a letter fallback and categories with a dark-red `?` ([#8](https://github.com/tschuegy/linkboard-nextcloud/issues/8)).
